Find the best score for each mode
text:
WITH mode_scores AS (
    SELECT mode, user_id, MAX(wpm) AS best_wpm
    FROM sprint_results
    WHERE accuracy >= 95
    GROUP BY mode, user_id
)
SELECT m.mode, u.name, m.best_wpm
FROM mode_scores AS m
JOIN users AS u ON u.id = m.user_id
WHERE m.best_wpm = (
    SELECT MAX(best_wpm)
    FROM mode_scores
    WHERE mode = m.mode
)
ORDER BY m.mode, u.name;

title: Find courses without enrollments
text:
SELECT
    c.id,
    c.title,
    d.name AS department
FROM courses AS c
JOIN departments AS d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e ON e.course_id = c.id
WHERE e.course_id IS NULL
  AND c.is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY d.name, c.title;

title: Compare monthly revenue
text:
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ordered_at) AS order_year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ordered_at) AS order_month,
        SUM(total_amount) AS revenue
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ordered_at),
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ordered_at)
)
SELECT order_year, order_month, revenue
FROM monthly_totals
WHERE revenue > 10000
ORDER BY order_year, order_month;
